main_body: sci-fi building with sloped metal roof and front wall
top_band: light blue-grey panelled roof slope with vents from row 0 to row 17 (light front edge at row 17)
evidence: Rows 0-17 show the foreshortened sloped roof surface with rooftop vents that themselves show top and front faces. Row 17 is a bright front-edge highlight of the roof, followed by the front facade (rows 18-44) with an orange trim band, inset windows with sills, and a recessed double doorway.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul reference buildings (which feature intricate per-tile roof shading, rich stone/timber textures, and 5-6 value steps), the candidate has large flat fills on the roof panels, wall panels, and windows, a stark near-black outline on the roof and window frames, and much lower per-tile detail density.
